clips.title: The story
paras: A Bottle of Zombie Juice is a potent, foul liquor brewed from the pungent rot blossom found in Duskwood. Procured from the tavern in Darkshire, it is supposedly requested by the reclusive hermit Abercrombie to ward off the chill of the gloomy woods.

Brewed from rot blossoms gathered among the shadowed soils of Duskwood, Zombie Juice is a remarkably harsh brew. The bartender who provides it warns that the drink is potent enough to raise the dead. While ordinary folk steer clear of such vile distillations, the eccentric hermit Abercrombie claims it is the only thing capable of keeping him warm on the damp, cold nights out by his lonely shack.
